items.description: Canadian apartment, house and condo locater service with a Google Map of rental listings. See comprehensive listings of apartments and houses for rent including photo galleries, a searchable map and amenity details.

Information and panoramic photos of places to visit in Tuscany, including Florence, Siena, Pisa, Lucca, Elba and San Gimignano. Interactive maps of areas of Tuscany with preset zoom levels and tourist information.
